decision.reason: One source/site/seed synthetic DEV pilot gives no D-only distant repair, one C-only row, the same near-position contrast, 4/22 damaged source-correct retention cases in C and D, and additional state/parameters/reference cost in D. Mechanics alone does not justify spending on a successor.
decision.successor_admission_requirement: A specific mechanistic new hypothesis plus minimal discriminating control, separately frozen configuration/data/analysis budget and exact reviewed run proposal. No automatic site/context/recovery/recurrence expansion.

guard_evidence_limits: Completion and unchanged guarded source establish checkpoints passed, not continuous free-RAM/free-VRAM traces; receipts do not persist numeric free-memory samples.
Qualification checks 2048 chunked-prefix inference and 17-token tokenwise inference only; not worst-shape training, padded/batched serving or full-length tokenwise qualification.
Six training records only exercise 42-259 input tokens; max_train_tokens=512 is an enforced upper limit, not empirical maximum-shape fit.
No training/qualification CUDA-peak/RSS peak record is stored in these completed receipts.
RSS per-row statistic excludes prefill samples and is not a transient allocator-level process peak.
Runtime guards are sampled before/after updates or chunks and after token generation; unobserved transient peaks remain possible.
Energy, optimized-kernel cost, broad serving cost and money expenditure are not measured.
Equal exposure does not equal parameter count or elapsed compute. D adds 1049744 parameters relative to C.

timing_semantics.CUDA_peaks: reset_peak_memory_stats before each row; loaded model included; peak counters read after check_cache; post-timed check_cache inspection may contribute allocations.
timing_semantics.RSS: Maximum sampled only after first-token timestamp and during decoding. Prefill resource calls enforce RSS ceiling but their numeric RSS is not added to per-row rss_sample_max_bytes.
timing_semantics.TTFT: Synchronized instrumented chunked prefill, finite checks and guards through first greedy argmax; excludes model loading/tokenization. Synthetic 8-token warmup occurred before DEV.
timing_semantics.decode: From first-token timestamp through decode loop and final synchronization. Includes initial post-prefill resource query, finite checks and per-token guards. Throughput numerator excludes first generated token; one-token completions null.
timing_semantics.stage_elapsed: Derived from request.created_utc before load_host through receipt.created_utc; includes model load/install and stage work, excludes binding/admission/startup before request and final serialization afterward. Wall-clock timestamps, no GPU-only or optimizer-only timer.
